name: Research: flicker hunt across every user-facing page, 1280 + 390, dev + local production build, watched over time
outcome: Walked all 10 user-facing routes in Aside (u2) at 1280/390/412-cold, signed out and in, across dev, the production build and read-only production — 28 hypotheses settled (13 confirmed, 8 refuted with controls, 6 clean, 1 artefact) plus 3 unlisted findings, delivered as ranked F1–F14 in four root-cause families; no product code
